narrative.overview:
CekBuah fills the viewport with a near-black center and teal, blue, and violet ambient light at the edges. An illustrated glass orb, lavender beam, orbit lines, and small flares give the headline its luminous focus. The page follows the user-pinned Clarid reference while replacing finance claims with supported fruits and real model details.

DM Serif Display gives the page an editorial voice; Manrope keeps controls, upload guidance, processing history, and results readable. The page moves from introduction to upload, five actual backend/model steps, then the ResNet50 label. Segar and Busuk use bright, distinct colors. The model result remains a visual estimate.
keyCharacteristics: A full-bleed dark canvas with teal, blue, and violet edge lighting; no floating outer app frame.
One editorial headline sits over an illustrated glass orb with a vertical lavender beam.
The proof strip uses supported fruits and the actual ResNet50 specifications.
Segar, Busuk, completed, and error states retain written labels with bright green/red color cues.

rules.name: The Truth-Only Proof Rule
rules.body: Use the supported fruit names and actual model specifications as proof. Do not add audience counts, partner claims, reliability claims, or an accuracy percentage to the interface.

rules.name: The Written Result Rule
rules.body: Segar and Busuk must remain visible words; color may reinforce a result but never replace its label.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Reserve the serif face for display and section titles. Keep controls, long copy, and status details in Manrope.

rules.name: The Border-and-Tone Rule
rules.body: The full-bleed page has no outer border or shadow. Use a quiet border or shadow only to separate working surfaces.

rules.name: The Processing Timeline Rule
rules.body: Keep backend events in their actual order and show the measured backend duration; a short UI dwell only makes fast running states readable.

dos: **Do** keep the first actions, supported fruit types, and ResNet50 purpose clear at a glance.
**Do** use the illustrated orb as a full-screen hero background behind the headline.
**Do** pair Segar and Busuk with written labels and bright, distinct green/red states.
**Do** preserve all five live processing steps, their order, and measured backend durations.
**Do** let the teal-blue-violet edge light blend into the full-bleed dark canvas.
donts: **Don't** add a floating rounded frame around the whole application.
**Don't** add invented partner names, audience counts, uptime claims, or an accuracy percentage to the UI.
**Don't** present a model result as a guarantee about the fruit's interior.
**Don't** let decorative lighting reduce the contrast of the headline or upload controls.
**Don't** hide an interactive state behind color alone.
